name: io.vulnify/mcp
title: Vulnify
description: Ask Vulnify before an AI agent acts. Check, record, and read policy decisions.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Sign in with Vulnify (OAuth 2.1). Leave this header empty. Set it only to send an API key (vln_live_... or vln_test_...) as a Bearer token. X-Vulnify-Key also works.

api_key.description: Optional Vulnify API key (vln_live_... or vln_test_...). Leave empty to sign in with Vulnify.

environmentVariables.name: VULNIFY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Vulnify API key (vln_live_... or vln_test_...) for the local stdio process. The hosted server signs in with Vulnify and does not need this variable.

environmentVariables.name: VULNIFY_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: API base URL. Defaults to https://api.vulnify.io.
